about: Registered explanations of gate failures (docs/PREREG_observer_advantage_keys.md, section 8). Each pins the numbers it explains; a rerun that changes them is unexplained again.

dispositions.explanation: The evidence supports GPU numerical variation (Colab A100) rather than harness drift: fp16 reproduces the record on all three Tier A models, Llama-2 nf4a passes G1 on the GV100, and Mistral's one-ulp jitter alone moves qasper 0.5 points. An inference, not a test (wording narrowed 2026-09-26).
